description: Single source of truth for Town of Wiley custom AWS resources (account 570912405222). Frontend hosting: S3 townofwiley-static-site + CloudFront E1NZ3XCY5CYR1J (d34qrz3qxoppc5.cloudfront.net) with townofwiley-spa-redirect Function (June 2026 migration; old Amplify app d331voxr1fhoir deleted). Best practices applied: managed CachingOptimized policy, custom Response Headers Policy (security + CSP ID 22d4bac1-d4fc-4e81-bb48-ab7df3a37c59), standard logging to townofwiley-cf-logs, OAC prepared (E1UXALBLRIDL2E created; bucket policy dual-grant ready; origin switch pending Console). Backend: Gen1 AppSync/DynamoDB/Cognito/Storage (stacks amplify-townofwiley-main-d1245-*) still prod; Gen2 definition + schema in amplify/ (data/resource.ts etc.) + inventory files ready but cutover incomplete (see docs/amplify-gen2-migration-plan.md: storage override + gen2-migration refactor/lock/retain blocked; runtime-config still Gen1; only Gen1 AppSync live). hosting.note: OAI still active in origin (OAC migration prepared: dual bucket policy + OAC resource E1UXALBLRIDL2E exists; CLI origin switch blocked with 'origin server' validation — complete via AWS Console: edit origin > Origin access control settings). Deploy uses improved cache controls (see README + scripts/deploy-static-site.sh).
hosting.deployCommand: npm run build && aws s3 sync dist/townofwiley-app/browser s3://townofwiley-static-site --delete --cache-control 'public, max-age=31536000, immutable' --exclude 'index.html' --exclude 'runtime-config.js' --exclude '*/*.html' && aws s3 sync dist/townofwiley-app/browser s3://townofwiley-static-site --delete --cache-control 'no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate' --include 'index.html' --include 'runtime-config.js' --include '*/*.html' && aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id E1NZ3XCY5CYR1J --paths "/*"

amplify.note: Legacy hosting app d331voxr1fhoir DELETED June 2026 after S3+CF migration. App ID and old stack names retained for historical backend references only. Repo + code cutover to Gen 2 complete (runtime links, /admin, docs, tests use x7poehudqvamneqni5s6e2cjxy as CURRENT; j7b2x3sh... marked GEN 1 LEGACY everywhere). Prod runtime CMS still on Gen1 pending full backend cutover (data copy via migrate script, update secrets for APPSYNC_CMS_*, ampx deploy or pipeline, verify, then decommission Gen1 stacks). Gen2 schema + inventory in amplify/ + infrastructure/gen2-*.json. See docs/amplify-gen2-migration-plan.md + gen1-decommission-evaluation.md.
